name: 3D watermarking benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating 3D watermarking methods, measuring robustness, imperceptibility, and resilience to attacks on 3D models.
evaluation_method: detection accuracy / bit error rate combined with imperceptibility metrics (PSNR, SSIM) and robustness under simulated attacks
general_score_metric: bit error rate and imperceptibility metrics (PSNR/SSIM); detection accuracy under attack
reputation: A specialized, older benchmark in multimedia security used within the 3D watermarking research community but not broadly adopted outside that niche.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; small and domain-specific dataset; results depend heavily on chosen attack models and evaluation settings, so cross-paper comparisons can be inconsistent.
